    A ≅ k ray A implies that A is standard in characteristic two (Theorem 11.8(2)) #

    "Proposition 8.3(2) and (3) give the initial-form comparison […] Combine them with Proposition 4.14 and Corollary 4.15 to obtain (1) and (2)."

    A multiplicative ray transversal killing the zero ray products (A ≅ k ray A) is a basis whose table presents A (selfPres). Proposition 8.3(2) presents A by the table P of A₀; Lemma 3.6 matches the two tables (IsRayPres.matchFn, IsRayPres.mul_iff), so A ≅ kP ≅ A₀ (algEquivA0_of_rayBasis), and A is standard by the converse of Corollary 4.15 (isStandard_of_algEquiv).

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
